required_evidence.name: security
required_evidence.expected: five workspaces report 0 vulnerabilities; secret scan exits 0

blockers.summary: The NestJS AppModule mounts no MVP business controllers or authentication boundary; current closed-loop evidence is at public-module level.
blockers.exit_criteria: Mount contract-conformant authenticated controllers and pass real HTTP cross-tenant and Web/API tests.

blockers.summary: Application and reporting data are in-memory and no production database migrations, durable queue integration, backup or restore implementation exists.
blockers.exit_criteria: Add durable repositories and reviewed forward/backward migrations, then complete a backup/restore drill against production-equivalent infrastructure.

blockers.summary: Data region, AI provider/cross-border policy, retention periods, RPO and RTO remain owner decisions with future due dates.
blockers.exit_criteria: Record approved decisions and configure providers, retention, backup frequency and recovery objectives accordingly.

blockers.summary: The repository-wide quality command is red because of pre-existing formatting and lint findings outside this ticket's write scope.
blockers.exit_criteria: Resolve the 40 Prettier findings and four review-workflow lint errors, then run npm.cmd --prefix tooling run quality successfully.

blockers.summary: Production infrastructure, TLS ingress, health/readiness endpoints, monitoring and alert routing are not defined in the repository.
blockers.exit_criteria: Add reviewed production IaC and observability, then execute deployment, smoke, incident-routing and rollback drills.
